Every "AI roadmap" I have been sent this year has the same slide.

Quarter one: pilots. Quarter two: scale the pilots. Quarter three: platform. Quarter four: a shape that is either a rocket or a carrot.

I asked one company what the pilots did. They had a chatbot that answered questions about the holiday policy. It got 30 questions a month. Twenty-two were about the chatbot.

The roadmap had a budget line of 1.4 million.

I am not against roadmaps. I am against a slide that costs more than the thing it describes.

Show me the 30 questions. Then show me the roadmap.
